text.p: Tropical Storm Levi is in the western Pacific, near 26/129e, moving northeast at 16 mph. Top winds are 50 mph but should slowly weaken during the next 48 hours. Levi is expected to pass southeast of Okinawa and south of Japan. This system will threaten shipping.
Tropical Storm Marie (06W), with 55 mph winds, is in the western Pacific near 16n/159e, moving north at 11 mph. This system strengthen during the next 24-36 hours.

Tropical Cyclone 37P, with 40 mph winds, is in the southern Pacific near 17s/168.5e, moving south-southeast at 9 mph. This system will begin to weaken and lose tropical characteristics by 24-36 hours. It is only a threat to shipping and should pass east of the island of Espiritu Santu.
